summary: High-performance, cloud-native vector database for storing and searching embeddings at scale in AI and RAG apps.

heroCommands.comment: Install the Python SDK with Milvus Lite

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: Milvus is an open-source vector database built for scale. It stores embeddings of text, images and other unstructured data and finds the most similar items quickly, which is the core of semantic search, recommendations and RAG apps.
sixtySeconds.problem: Searching millions or billions of vectors fast needs specialised indexing and infrastructure. Milvus provides that with hardware acceleration and a distributed, Kubernetes-native design, and also a lightweight local mode for getting started.
whoFor: Developers building RAG and semantic search
ML engineers running similarity search at scale
Teams deploying vector search on Kubernetes
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for a mature, high-performance vector database that scales from a local file (Milvus Lite) to large distributed clusters, under the LF AI & Data Foundation.
requirements: Docker or Kubernetes for a full server

overview: Milvus is written in Go and C++ with CPU and GPU acceleration. Its distributed, Kubernetes-native architecture scales horizontally.

Install pymilvus, the Python SDK, and use MilvusClient. With Milvus Lite you create a local database just by giving a file name; you can also connect to a deployed Milvus server or Zilliz Cloud with a URI and token. Then create collections, insert data and search.
Milvus is an LF AI & Data Foundation project under Apache 2.0, with Zilliz as its main contributor; Zilliz Cloud is a managed option.
limitations: Full clusters take effort to operate
Lite mode is for small projects and testing

firstRun.title: Create a local database and a collection
firstRun.code:
from pymilvus import MilvusClient

client = MilvusClient("milvus_demo.db")
client.create_collection(collection_name="demo_collection", dimension=768)
